description: Core 0.38.0 leaves attaching the proxy map to the consumer's release builder and nothing in release/ does. CI keeps proxy-map-<build id> for 90 days. How the builder fetches the artifact is the design question; ideally `build_release.py --record` refuses a release with no map. release/ is not a DLL input, so no new 20-pass run. Raised: J78 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: d3d9.map on releases
